official_sources.name: EA LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud

verified_facts: EA point cloud is an archive of 3D x-y-z points
timestamped DSM/DTM raster products are derived from point clouds
point cloud is available for surveys back to 2006
not every timestamped surface model necessarily has a matching point cloud
historic archiving can explain missing point-cloud matches
point clouds classify ground and surface-object returns
manual DTM editing means classified ground points need not equal final DTM
point cloud may be used only when an actual matching survey is demonstrated
quality_effect: Blocks false independence or false matching claims between raster surfaces and point-cloud archives.
